source_locator.description: Muthan is taken toward the gallows through a large crowd; his friends create a diversion, remove him, and soldiers take a black-masked prisoner onward believing him to be Muthan.

translation.english_text: [Muthan is being taken to the gallows... A huge crowd. Muthan's friends are among them. Maappillaithaasu Swamigal, Baladevar and Sukhadev are also there. Muthan's friends communicate by signs.... Suddenly confusion breaks out in the crowd. Muthan's friends take Muthan away. The confusion subsides. The soldiers, mistaking a black-masked prisoner for Muthan, drag him toward the gallows.]
notes: The source presents the rescue and mistaken-prisoner substitution entirely as stage action; English does not invent dialogue or identify the masked prisoner before the next scene reveals him.
